title: RoutingDecision
description: Routing output: executable path, outcome metrics, and optional runtime-constraint state

original_action_id.description: Action emitted by the learned/greedy policy before the runtime constraint

safety_override.description: True when the executable action differs from original_action_id

safe_action_mask.description: Safe status for direct, satellite, and mesh at the configured threshold

no_safe_route.description: True when all three executable routes exceed the threat threshold

network_action.description: Concrete data-plane behavior corresponding to the routing decision

reward.description: RL step reward for this decision

recovery_ms.description: Time to recover from jamming in milliseconds (null if no jamming detected)
